spec.description:
Bradford Acoustigard is a premium, Australian-made
non-combustible glasswool insulation available in partition batts and rolls,
specifically engineered to deliver high-performance acoustic control in internal
partition walls. Manufactured from molten glass containing up to 65% recycled
content using biosoluble FBS-1 formulation, it provides sound transmission loss
and cavity absorption in commercial steel stud and timber wall assemblies. It is
non-combustible, low-allergen, and sized to fit standard 64mm and 92mm steel
stud walls without causing plasterboard bulge.
features:
Non-combustible
bulk insulation complying with AS 1530.1

High acoustic performance helping
achieve Rw/STC ratings of 42 to 60+ in partition walls

Available in partition
rolls and pre-cut batts sized for 450mm and 600mm commercial stud centres
Manufactured from up to 65% recycled glass content

Friction-fit dimensions
designed to fit 64mm and 92mm steel studs without bulging wall linings

FBS-1
bio-soluble glasswool formulation assessed as non-hazardous

Zero Ozone
Depleting Potential (ODP) and non-toxic with low VOC emissions

Early Fire
Hazard indices of 0/0/0/1 to AS/NZS 1530.3

Maximum service temperature up
to 150°C (batts) and 300°C (rolls)

Thermal performance ratings from R1.3 to
R2.7 in accordance with AS/NZS 4859.1

install:
Confirm framing
stud spacing (450mm or 600mm centres) and cavity depth

Ensure electrical
wiring and plumbing penetrations are roughed in prior to insulation

Friction-fit Acoustigard batts or unroll partition rolls vertically between
studs

Ensure the insulation fills the stud cavity snugly without gaps, voids,
or excessive compression

Cut neatly around electrical junction boxes,
nogging, and service penetrations using an insulation knife

Fix plasterboard
linings directly over studs, ensuring insulation remains in place without
bulging linings
selection_checklist:
Confirm stud depth
(64mm, 75mm, 92mm) and spacing (450mm or 600mm centres)

Confirm acoustic
engineer specification (density 11kg, 14kg, 24kg, or 32kg/m3 and required Rw
rating)

Choose between pre-cut batts (faster handling) or continuous rolls
(longer continuous drops)

Verify non-combustibility requirement under NCC for
commercial wall assemblies

Check thermal R-value requirement if wall
separates conditioned and unconditioned spaces
accessories:
Personal protective equipment (gloves, dust mask, safety
glasses)
limitations:
Not designed for direct weather-exposed external
applications without waterproof building wrap

Do not over-compress into studs
narrower than the nominal insulation thickness

Not suitable for continuous
operating temperatures exceeding 150°C (batts) or 300°C (rolls)

use_cases:
Friction-fitting into 64mm and 92mm steel stud drywall partitions in commercial
office fitouts to achieve Rw 45 to Rw 55+

Acoustic and thermal infill in
multi-residential intertenancy party walls

Sound-dampening insulation inside
healthcare consulting rooms, hotel guestroom partitions, and cinema acoustic
walls
not_for: Flooring underlay under tiles or timber
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Acoustigard is a non-combustible bio-soluble glasswool
insulation supplied in pre-cut batts and rolls, specifically formulated for
acoustic control in commercial steel stud and timber drywall partitions.
Available in densities from 11 kg/m3 to 32 kg/m3 and thicknesses of 50mm, 75mm,
and 90mm (R1.3 to R2.7), it provides high sound transmission loss (Rw 42 to 60+)
and cavity absorption. Manufactured in Australia with up to 65% recycled glass
and certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1, it fits standard 64mm and 92mm studs
snugly without bulging plasterboard linings.
